hypotheses.justification: The `variable` line declares `[IsSimpleGroup G]`, and Lean adds it as an argument of `z_eq_pow` because its only dependency, `G`, is already an argument. Nothing in the statement or proof uses it. The statement uses `Hyp25T p f Ω K K' W S R R' z t u₁ u₂ t'`, which is `T7F2.Hyp25T`, defined in AscT7F2Ctx.lean. That structure only needs `[Group G] [Finite G] [Fact p.Prime]`. The proof is `T7QEng.z_eq_pow_gen h.hzR c`. `h.hzR` is `Hyp25T.hzR`, declared in the same file under `variable {G} [Group G] [Finite G] {p f} [Fact p.Prime] ...` with no `IsSimpleGroup`. `z_eq_pow_gen` itself only assumes `[Group G] [Finite G]`. So the theorem and its proof go through unchanged after `omit [IsSimpleGroup G] in`. The file already sets `linter.unusedSectionVars false`, which hides the warning that would otherwise flag this variable.
